foundation_gate.evidence_origin: Lead read-only remote connector readback in this session; not an independent worker network probe.
foundation_gate.observed: No app-foundation/app-learning branch in listing; foundation marker lookup returned 404/no commit found.

source_evidence.historical_source_status_snapshot: docs/geomath-app/SOURCES_AND_STATUS.md is older provenance, not current integration or hosted status.
source_evidence.provider_source: Prompt 3 provider branch/current native capability requires owning auth audit; provider behavior in this matrix is acceptance, not a verified deployment.
source_evidence.readiness_inference: Requirements are reviewable, but no READY foundation means native acceptance cannot be exercised.

runtime_evidence.historical_web_suite_receipts: Source reports only; not rerun here and not Flutter/device/hosted acceptance.

visual_evidence.claim: Catalog board mapping only; no PNG, pixel, native screenshot or mockup layout approval.

shared_ownership.neutral_game_cards: app-foundation GeometryCardProvider; no dependency on unfinished learning implementation
shared_ownership.record_writer_port_and_reader_schema: app-foundation freeze; app-cloud-game signed-in atomic writer/outbox; app-learning consumes port

cross_cutting_acceptance.applies_to: Every entry in screens and supplemental_states, where the context is applicable; no native item is passed or waived by this audit.
rules: Use the frozen foundation shell/contribution bootstrap, shared token mapping from pinned digital/design-system/tokens.mjs and shared components; no independent feature theme, global route, core or schema edits.
BM is default; English/light/dark/system/contrast/text 100/125/150%/reduced-motion/audio share one preferences owner and preserve current draft, selection, attempt and context.
All native touch targets >=48 dp; semantic names/order/status, non-color labels, focus restoration, safe areas and keyboard insets; accessible tap choice in addition to drag.

UI consumes repository/controller state, never performs raw SQL/RPC from base widget or fabricates acknowledged success; preserve applicable loading/empty/error/retry/offline/pending/conflict/recovery states.
Server owns role/current membership/online scores/timing; route guard is not authorization. Scope each async request/response to actor/session/epoch/room and ignore stale results.
Credentials exist only in protected session/capability handling, never serialized UI DTO, business SQLite/outbox, WebView, screenshot/log/handoff/report.
Android system/gesture/app-bar back uses one policy: solo pauses/checkpoints remaining review, Duel confirms forfeit and keeps deadline, class resyncs server state; one audio/polling/refresh owner.
Mockups are visual proposals, not executable pages or canonical answer/math sources; maintain cone and neutral game/net cards without unique color answer cues.
EX11 is presented by learning through shared failure port; cloud owns signed-in persistence/outbox failure and atomically rejects partial record/event writes.

required_visual_matrix.coverage: all 29 owned IDs and all 16 supplemental states
negative_layout_checks: no focus loss after failed refresh

required_native_validation_after_ready.precondition: Read real frozen signatures/hashes at the same READY SHA used by app-learning; resolve shared gaps by integration request.
required_native_validation_after_ready.preview_requirement: Run Android preview using real repository/controller and frozen contribution bootstrap; clearly labeled fixtures remain test-only.
receipts_required: at least one physical Android model/OS before claiming tested phone APK
separate authorized hosted Auth/CRUD/sync/two-client Duel receipts

negative_cases: At 320/390/430/768 dp in BM/English, light/dark and text 150%, reject clipped/keyboard-covered primary actions, unsafe-area collisions, inaccessible choices and unusable tables/sheets.
Also cover text 100/125%, system theme, strong contrast, reduced motion and supported orientation changes; settings must preserve draft/selection/attempt context.
Verify native targets at least 48 dp, TalkBack names/order/state, tap alternatives to drag, invalid-field focus, stable loading focus and focus return after dialog cancellation.
Exercise applicable loading/empty/error/retry/offline/saving/success/conflict/unknown-outcome/pending/needs-auth/unavailable/storage-failed/access-revoked presentations with actual controller state.
Learning accepts only net/volume/area/composite and canonical validation: prediction <=240, result <=600, explanation <=600; completed requires a valid explanation.
A failed signed-in record-plus-outbox transaction returns storage failure to learning; do not claim a saved reflection or synced receipt; actor switch and duplicate receipt do not cross owners.

T06.purpose: Solo engine parity and staged input
negative_cases: Golden traces from the real pinned JS engine compare every state after explicit RNG-draw and clock input; a Dart Random(seed) assumption is insufficient.
Cover wrong R1, wrong R2, premature R2, select without scan, double-tap scan/Continue, skip and repeated hint; only a complete correct pair earns +1 once; untouched R2 is notAttempted.
Quiz selects 2 per canonical shape; practice uses all 15 unique questions; cone is retained and no round question repeats.
BLINK_MS=900, WRONG_MS=1200, REVIEW_MS=1800; correct advances after 900; wrong/skip needs explicit Continue after >=1800; WRONG_MS never auto-advances.
Kill/reopen in R1, R2, correct feedback and wrong/skip review; restore fractional elapsed and remaining feedback/review instead of an expired wall-clock deadline.
Reject corrupt/schema/ruleset/exact-bank/actor mismatch; denied/full storage must not claim durable save; confirm before replacing the one owner/device checkpoint slot.

Duplicate finalization yields one history/event and at most one quiz score row; cap local quiz scores at 50; exclude practice/review/classroom/Duel and preserve original results during retry-subset practice.
Username 2/3/24/25 boundaries and normalization, display-name 1/2/60/61 and Unicode validator parity, password 9/10/128/129, invalid email and duplicate username; server role remains authoritative.

Cold/warm/expired/reused/duplicate callback, old callback or refresh after logout/account switch, invalid/raw reset route and mismatched recovery session cannot change password or adopt the wrong actor.

Email confirmation/recovery is link-based; legacy recovery is the existing 32-hex code; SMS is excluded from current product scope; observed source-provider OTP 6/cooldown 60 s is audit-only and stays disabled unless explicitly reintroduced.

Provider/RPC unavailable and unknown password/logout outcome have explicit recovery actions; test save/discard/stay, serialized session mutations and actual logout scopes without claiming immediate access-JWT revocation or single-device revoke.
Use teacher, student and outsider across two classes: non-owner mutations, wrong/current membership, revoked access and late old-class responses; clear denied cache/subscriptions.
Exactly six-digit PIN including leading zero, malformed/expired/rotated PIN, class-vs-room semantics, 24 h expiry, same-attempt reopen and open/playing/terminal-closed boundaries.
Validate trimmed 2-60 Unicode code-point names without controls; revision must be a nonnegative JSON integer; reject unknown payload fields and supplied owner IDs.
Conflict preserves draft and requires explicit refresh; unknown-outcome destructive mutation refreshes/reconciles before retry; playing blocks applicable archive/remove and delete is empty-only.
Archive retains history, invalidates scoped PINs; restore never revives old PIN or opens closed room; removal preserves attempts/results and valid re-enrollment returns the same attempt.
Stale invitation issuance UUID cannot affect a newer invitation; cancel_invite and decline_invite payload is invite_id only, with no expected_revision.
Use two independent clients including a guest; both Ready precede the 3 s countdown; full/expired lobby, 10 min PIN and 15 min match are server decisions.
Lost ack/duplicate seq/reconnect resends the exact pending payload and seq; reject wrong room/epoch/older projection, double input and premature advance.
Durable correct 900 ms and wrong/skip >=1800 ms review survives reconnect, including the last question after room complete; no scan/skip/hint during review.
Dialog/background/disconnect keeps server time running; system/gesture/app-bar back confirms forfeit; cancellation does not pause; server finalizes deadline/forfeit.

429/Retry-After/backoff and single polling/refresh ownership; protocol/backend mismatch stops rather than falling back; active shape/original bank ID and opponent token/seq/answers/attempts/hint remain hidden.

T11.purpose: Atomic native formative storage and bounded delivery
negative_cases: Record and pending event commit in one SQLite transaction; inject write failure/crash, reopen DB, queue full at 2000/owner and duplicate finalization; no silent eviction or durable promise after failure.

Flush <=20 events; validate ack as a unique subset of sent IDs; partial ack removes only accepted IDs; missing/invalid/duplicate/foreign ack keeps unconfirmed events; ack-write failure remains recoverable.
Immutable event ID/content_version=1/payload and canonical ruleset: same-ID changed content rejected; no auth/CRUD/PIN/live class/Duel/help actions or official scores in queue.
A->B or logout while save/send/ack waits must not send A using B or apply A to B; guests never auto-upload or transfer; credential never enters DB/outbox/WebView/log/report.

Expired session -> needs-auth, missing RPC -> unavailable with queue retained, permanent/validation failure -> stop auto-retry; transient retry/backoff/jitter/Retry-After is bounded and single-flight.
Foreground/reopen/manual retry is the primary delivery trigger; no force-stop/background delivery guarantee; connectivity alone never means synced.

Run real repository/controller native preview and Android integration/device lifecycle; collect model/OS/build and actual screenshots; fixture or static mockup results cannot satisfy native acceptance.

Keep analyze/unit/widget/DB, debug APK build, emulator, physical phone and authorized hosted checks separate; source history/build cannot prove Google consent, SMS delivery, iOS or 5000-user capacity.

screens.title: Pilih permainan
acceptance: Offer only cube/cuboid/pyramid/cylinder/cone, with bundled canonical BM/English bank of 15 unique IDs and 3 questions per shape; no Prisma replacement.
Quiz starts 10 questions with 2 per shape; practice uses all 15 without repetition. Keep guest solo usable offline and when cloud config is unavailable.
First-play help reuses foundation screen 04 before the solo clock begins; replacing an existing owner/device slot requires confirmation.

screens.title: Sambung permainan
acceptance: Show the owner checkpoint summary before resuming its existing attempt; keep one slot per guest/account/device and confirm replacement.
Validate actor, schema/version, single-attempt-v1 ruleset and exact bank identity through canonical snapshot replay; corrupt/incompatible data gets explicit recovery UI.
Restore R1/R2, selected card, hints, fractional elapsed and remaining feedback/review; never consume background/dialog time or expose another owner slot.

screens.title: Kuiz 10
acceptance: Run exactly 10 unique questions, 2 per canonical shape, using JS-trace parity with explicit RNG draws and clock.
Card selection is separate from scan: accept R1 solid then R2 net, one attempt, +1 only a fully correct pair; wrong stage/skip gives 0 and untouched R2 remains notAttempted.
Use neutral foundation cards, all five accessible choices and tap alternatives; hint is free and counted once. Pause/checkpoint solo clock on dialogs/background.

screens.title: Latihan 15
acceptance: Practice uses every canonical bank ID once: 15 questions, 3 per cube/cuboid/pyramid/cylinder/cone; staged input, scoring, hint and timing match the real JS engine.
Preserve same-owner checkpoint and remaining review time across lifecycle; a practice/review result never enters quiz leaderboard.
Retrying wrong/skipped IDs creates a separate review activity and leaves the original analysis/history unchanged.

screens.title: Semakan jawapan
acceptance: Present canonical attempts/outcome with labels: wrong R1 or R2 and skip give 0, correct pair +1 once, untouched R2 is notAttempted.
Correct feedback auto-advances after BLINK_MS=900; WRONG_MS=1200 is feedback only; wrong/skip waits for Continue after REVIEW_MS>=1800.
Ignore premature/double scan/Continue and repeated hint counting; restore remaining feedback/review after dialog/background/process death.

screens.title: Keputusan dan analisis
acceptance: Render actual completed attempt totals, per-shape/topic/reader analysis and wrong/skipped IDs; distinguish R2 notAttempted from wrong.
Finalize completed history/event exactly once via the shared writer; persistence failure/pending/synced labels follow durable receipt and valid ack.
Practice the original wrong/skipped question IDs without rewriting original result; completed solo is formative, not an official classroom/Duel score.

screens.title: Papan skor kuiz setempat
acceptance: Show only the current owner/device local quiz leaderboard, maximum 50 entries and at most one row per attempt.
Exclude practice, retry review, classroom and Duel; show genuine empty/read/storage failure states instead of seeded mockup scores.

screens.title: Cipta/sertai Duel
acceptance: Create/join via actual protocol-2 transport with explicit online/capability availability and genuine validation/error state.
Permit guest Duel using a separate protected player capability token; account login is not a prerequisite and credentials never enter formative outbox.
Keep an unresolved create/join pending payload stable for reconciliation; never manufacture an acknowledged lobby from local UI state.

screens.title: Lobi Duel
acceptance: Show at most two players from validated server state; countdown 3 seconds only after both players are Ready, with 10 shared questions.
Respect server lobby PIN expiry of 10 minutes; ready/create/join is single-flight and full/expired/PIN errors have actionable state.
Do not expose prompts/answer identities during countdown or let settings/background restart the lobby clock.

screens.title: Duel berlangsung
acceptance: Use validated protocol-2 server projection; never call local solo scan/skip/advance to change Duel score or time.
Preserve room/token/seq/questionIndex wire fields and retry identical payload+seq after unknown outcome. CurrentQuestion hides shape/original bank ID; opponent is summary only.

Correct advance waits for server 900 ms gate, wrong/skip for Continue after >=1800 ms; durable review blocks extra inputs. Server 15 minute clock continues through dialog/background/disconnect; back routes through EX12.

screens.title: Keputusan Duel
acceptance: Render acknowledged server completion, winner/tiebreaker and permitted completed-answer analysis; local timeout never fabricates final scores.
Allow advance of the final pending review even after room complete, then reconcile server projection.
Expose no opponent private token/seq/answers/attempts/hint and do not write Duel results into local quiz leaderboard or formative live-action outbox.

screens.title: Log masuk
acceptance: Email/username login uses the canonical gateway and protected SDK session adoption; lowercase/trim username, validate source limits and trust only server-owned role.
Serialize login/logout/provider mutation; bind async work to user/session/epoch/scope and reject stale callback/refresh after account switch.

Cloud/provider absence has unavailable action while guest learning/solo remains usable. Google requires current audited native capability/config; phone/SMS remains disabled in current scope. No fabricated provider success.

screens.title: Daftar akaun
acceptance: Signup follows gateway: username 3-24 [a-z0-9_], display name 2-60 and password 10-128 with valid email; server establishes the role/profile.
Show email-confirmation-required from the real response and verified link callback; do not substitute an email OTP or auto-confirm a local form.
Provider profile completion requires verified provider identity and available geo_complete_profile contract; never change an existing profile role from client metadata.

screens.title: Pemulihan akaun
acceptance: Request the actual email recovery link through source SDK/gateway; protect sensitive inputs and use neutral acknowledged request messaging.
Handle cold/warm/expired/reused/duplicate callback and recovery session binding before allowing screen 46; route navigation alone has no reset permission.
Offer EX14 only for the existing legacy source recovery flow; never relabel its 32-hex code or email link as a new six-digit email OTP.

screens.title: Dashboard guru
acceptance: Show server-verified teacher dashboard with existing owned classes/rooms, meaningful empty/create state and labeled read-only cache when allowed.
Revalidate session/ownership; expose CRUD only with classroom_crud:1; coalesce snapshot refresh and preserve selected scope/drafts on failure.
Access denial removes stale scope/cache/subscription and does not look like a successful empty list or silently allow cached mutation.

screens.title: Ahli dan jemputan kelas
acceptance: Only the owning teacher manages current members, invitations and genuine six-digit class PIN with source 24 hour expiry/rotation.
Invitation actions use the exact issuance UUID; stale dialogs cannot accept/cancel/decline a newer issuance and invite actions do not send expected_revision.
Remove-member checks server current authorization/playing state and revision, retains history/attempts and clears revoked scope access; valid re-enrollment restores the original attempt.

screens.title: Pantau bilik
acceptance: Owner monitors real server room open->playing->closed state; closed is terminal and waiting players are not shown as final zero-score attempts.
Timing, game progress and status come from server; use a single scoped/coalesced refresh/heartbeat owner and revalidate membership/ownership.
Offline UI cannot start/replay live class actions; playing boundaries prevent relevant archive/remove operations and foreground resync restores current server state.

screens.title: Keputusan bilik
acceptance: Display real room results ordered by score then shortest answering elapsed, excluding waiting/review time; no synthetic completed-zero players.
Keep classroom history outside quiz leaderboard and formative client-score uploads; preserve attempt/history after archive/member removal.
Label any permitted cached results stale/read-only; denied access clears old data/subscriptions and uses current server authorization.

screens.title: Dashboard pelajar
acceptance: Show server student role/current class memberships, issued invitations and join/open-existing-class actions; guest route entry cannot confer student role.
Accept/decline the exact invitation issuance UUID, handling expiry/stale issuance and denied membership without applying old actor/class responses.
Label allowed cached dashboard read-only and revalidate before mutation; no live PIN/invitation/class actions enter offline outbox.

screens.title: Bilik pelajar
acceptance: Current member waits for teacher, then starts/resumes the single server attempt for that student/room; reopen never creates a second attempt.
Use shared solo visual components only: server owns class answers/clock/ranking; closed room never reopens and live class actions/results never enter solo leaderboard or formative action queue.
Revalidate membership including live removal; clear denied snapshots/subscriptions, reject stale room/actor response and foreground-resync server time.

screens.title: Profil saya
acceptance: Maintain explicit profile draft and server baseline; save only validated name/avatar through real repository with single-flight durable acknowledgement, not optimistic success.
Back/navigation uses EX13 Save/Discard/Stay; refresh/error/theme/language change preserves draft and focus. Account switch follows frozen privacy boundary and ignores old response.
Profile edits never change server-owned role; verified-provider completion is capability-gated and cannot reassign an existing profile role.

screens.title: Kata laluan dan keselamatan
acceptance: Use audited password-change reauthentication and new-password/confirmation 10-128 validation; preserve current actor/session binding through await.
Represent actual current/others/all logout scopes and unknown update/logout outcome; do not claim existing access JWTs revoke immediately or invent one-device revocation.
Secrets stay in protected session handling/transient fields, never business SQLite, WebView, outbox, logs, screenshots or reports.

screens.title: Cipta kelas
acceptance: Server-verified teacher creates a class via create_class with trimmed name of 2-60 Unicode code points without controls; use reusable name form/controller.
Validate against effective source/server 2-60 boundary rather than rendered maxlength=120; preserve draft/focus on error and reconcile unknown create outcome before another create.
Show acknowledged class and its actual PIN/expiry only; no local invented owner/role or cached-offline create.

screens.title: Cipta bilik
acceptance: Only owning teacher in active class creates room via create_room with class_id and trimmed 2-60 Unicode name without controls; form/controller reused for page or sheet.
Preserve draft/single-flight/unknown-outcome reconciliation; archived/unauthorized scope cannot create and local UI cannot reopen closed room.
Use acknowledged room and actual six-digit PIN/24 h expiry; server remains authority for status, bank, clock and score.

screens.title: Sertai kelas/bilik melalui PIN
acceptance: Validate exactly six digits as text including leading zeros; PIN class joins class, PIN room joins class plus that room; reject invalid/expired/rotated PIN using server state.
Only authorized student/current session can join; source PIN expiry is 24 h and archive/closed boundaries remain enforced.
After join/reopen use the same server student/room attempt; no offline PIN queue, silent retry creating new attempt or role from route alone.

screens.title: Sahkan e-mel
acceptance: Email verification state follows actual confirmation-required/verified SDK/server session and real resend-link response; never accepts a fabricated six-digit email OTP.
Validate native callback allowlist/session binding on cold/warm start; invalid/expired/reused/duplicate/stale account callback gives explicit recovery and no unintended session adoption.
Resend/config/provider failure stays truthful and single-flight; live email delivery or provider consent is not proven by a fixture/build.

screens.title: Kata laluan baharu
acceptance: Permit new password only under the verified recovery session identity, with 10-128 new password and matching confirmation; opening /auth/reset is insufficient.
Reject expired/reused/duplicate/old actor recovery callbacks, serialize SDK mutation and clear recovery intent only according to the acknowledged source flow.
Unknown update/logout outcome requires explicit recovery/reconciliation; never persist password, raw link or OTP to SQLite/log/outbox.

screens.title: Sesi aktif
acceptance: List actual geo_security_sessions server records, current-session marker and recorded/expired state; use estimated device labels rather than invented precise device/location evidence.
Use only API-supported current/others/all logout scopes and refresh acknowledged list; no invented single-device revoke or immediate access-JWT invalidation.
Expired session, failure, stale callback and account swap cannot show/adopt another account session list.

screens.title: Sambungan Duel terganggu
acceptance: Present a reconnect/resync state of screen 12 on the same proposed match route, retaining protected capability and exact pending payload/seq.
Server clock/deadline continues while offline/background/dialog; foreground resumes pending reconciliation then validated projection without applying old room/epoch responses.
One polling/refresh owner, bounded transient retry/Retry-After; incompatible protocol/backend stops explicitly. Pending live command never enters formative offline queue.

supplemental_states.title: Sunting nama kelas
acceptance: Send rename_class payload exactly class_id, expected_revision, name; revision is nonnegative integer and trimmed name is 2-60 Unicode code points without controls.
Require classroom_crud:1 and owner; retain draft on failure/conflict, explicitly refresh before retry, and reuse the screen-42 name form.

supplemental_states.title: Sunting nama bilik
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Nama berubah tanpa mengubah status atau markah
acceptance: Send rename_room payload exactly room_id, expected_revision, name; same name/revision/owner/capability validator as source, reusing screen-43 name form.
Rename cannot change room status, bank, timing or score; preserve draft/focus after conflict or unknown outcome and reconcile before retry.

supplemental_states.title: Pengesahan arkib
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Nama skop, kesan PIN dan blok semasa playing
acceptance: Name the class/room and explain scoped PIN invalidation/history retention before archive; cancel returns focus and dangerous CTA has a specific action label.
archive_class uses class_id+expected_revision; archive_room uses room_id+expected_revision. Capability/owner/server guards block relevant playing scope and no optimistic success is shown.

supplemental_states.title: Senarai arkib / restore
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Restore tidak membuka closed room atau kod lama
acceptance: List archived scopes with retained permitted results; restore_class uses class_id+expected_revision and restore_room room_id+expected_revision under actual owner/capability checks.
Restore never opens a closed room, revives old PIN or invents a new code; active/archive filters preserve context and server denial clears revoked data.

supplemental_states.title: Pengesahan padam rekod kosong
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Semak server; unknown outcome refresh sebelum retry
acceptance: Delete requires source capability/owner and server-empty class (no members/rooms/invitations) or non-playing room (no room members/attempts/progress).

Send only class_id+expected_revision or room_id+expected_revision, confirm named scope, preserve cancel focus and refresh/reconcile an unknown outcome before any retry; never auto-repeat destructive delete.

supplemental_states.title: Keluarkan ahli kelas
acceptance: Send remove_member exactly class_id, user_id, expected_revision; require owning teacher/capability and no class room playing.

Retain attempts, answers, scores, reflections and room history; revoke current class access/cache/subscriptions without banning account or deleting the original attempt; valid re-enrollment restores that attempt.

supplemental_states.title: Batal/tolak jemputan
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: UUID issuance baharu tidak dipengaruhi dialog lama
acceptance: Owning teacher cancels or named student declines a pending invitation with invite_id only; never append expected_revision or owner fields.
Bind confirmation to the issuance UUID so old dialogs cannot affect a newer invitation; reconcile unknown result and retain current context/focus.

supplemental_states.title: Conflict revision / refresh
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Tunjuk nama terkini sambil kekalkan draf
acceptance: Conflict keeps unsaved input and requires explicit refresh to show latest server name/revision beside the retained draft.
Retry is an explicit user choice using the refreshed intended revision; no silent overwrite, automatic destructive replay or cached success masking conflict.

supplemental_states.title: Senarai pending sync
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Bilangan sebenar, retry dan status setiap kumpulan
acceptance: Show exact owner-scoped pending counts/groups and actual local/pending/syncing/synced/needs-auth/unavailable/blocked/storage-failed state, with bounded retry action.
Record+event is atomic; batches <=20, cap <=2000/owner, immutable ID+payload and only individual valid accepted IDs removed. No valid ack means no synced label.
Allow only four canonical module reflections and completed solo formative history; guest/auth/CRUD/PIN/live class/Duel/help never queue and no official score is asserted.

supplemental_states.title: Login semula untuk sync
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Owner sama; jangan hantar queue menggunakan akaun lain
acceptance: Expired session marks needs-auth and stops automatic delivery while retaining the same owner pending records.
Reauthentication must confirm the original owner/session binding before retry; switching to B/guest never sends or transfers A records and stale save/send/ack cannot mutate new actor UI.

supplemental_states.title: Storan gagal/penuh
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Belum disimpan; tiada silent eviction atau janji durable
acceptance: Learning presents storage-failed/full when the frozen FormativeRecordWriter port returns failure; app-cloud-game owns signed-in writer/outbox atomic rollback and failure behavior.

Never announce durable save or synced after failed record+event transaction, denied/full DB or cap 2000; no silent eviction. Preserve in-memory unsaved state only as supported and distinguish it from durable recovery.
Foundation supplies shared failure type and guest/local writer; reuse that port and shared notice instead of duplicating schema, reflection store or learning presentation.

supplemental_states.title: Keluar Duel / forfeit
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Pengesahan jelas; clock tetap terus berjalan
acceptance: System/gesture/app-bar back uses the same explicit named leave/forfeit confirmation; cancelling returns to the current match without pausing server clock.
Send actual protocol forfeit and await/reconcile server outcome; dialog/background/disconnect keeps match deadline running and local navigation never invents final result.

supplemental_states.title: Draf belum disimpan
acceptance: Dirty profile navigation offers Save, Discard or Stay; save is single-flight and only actual acknowledgement updates baseline, error keeps draft.
Keep focus/draft through refresh/preferences changes; apply frozen account-switch draft policy and ignore old actor save/callback instead of transferring private draft.

supplemental_states.title: Pemulihan akaun legacy
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Kod lama hanya melalui aliran source; bukan OTP baharu
acceptance: Use only existing legacy gateway recover flow for legacy accounts without email: normalized username, saved 32-hex recovery_code and new password 10-128.
Email accounts continue using recovery links; do not invent an email/SMS OTP replacement, expose secret code in logs/DB/outbox or bypass verified recovery-session rules for email reset.

supplemental_states.title: Cache read-only / akses ditarik
acceptance: Read-only cache explicitly labels local/stale origin and update time where relevant; remembered offline owner is not server authorization and mutations require revalidation.

Revoked membership/authorization clears affected cache/subscription/result and returns to allowed scope; actor/session/epoch/scope guards reject late old success and coalesced cache cannot conceal denial.

supplemental_states.title: Backend capability belum tersedia
supplemental_states.catalog_behavior: Tiada kawalan mati; pending disimpan jika sync belum dipasang
acceptance: Use actual capability/config to hide unsupported provider/CRUD actions and show actionable unavailable notice rather than an inert working-looking control or fabricated success.
Missing offline-sync RPC retains pending and stops automatic retry; protocol/backend mismatch stops Duel; guest local learning/solo remains available without cloud config.
Record provider/native callback/platform/backend prerequisites for integration; source presence/build is not a hosted activation receipt.
